text:
Emma: Quick heads-up — launching the product landing + webinar next Wed. Need X + LinkedIn posts (teaser, launch, reminder) and a small thread. Also need inbound routing: send signups to HubSpot -> AE queue if MQL. Can we finalize schedule and assets today?

Sam: SGTM. My plan: 3 X posts (teaser, launch, reminder), 2 LinkedIn posts (short + long). Will also run a 3-tweet thread for the benchmark narrative. Which time slots work for ops?

Anya: I have weekday slots open at 10:30am, 1:00pm, 4:30pm PT. Prefer teaser at 10:30, launch at 1:00, reminder at 4:30. Need final copy + images by tomorrow 10:00am PT to queue.

Leo: I can draft copy variants. For the launch post do we want the benchmark stat up front? e.g., "2x latency, 3x cost savings" then link to blog? I can prepare short, medium, long variants and a thread plan for the benchmarks.

Maggie: Figma comps are almost done. Uploading to figma now: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/launch-assets (placeholder). Exporting PNGs and 1:1 carousel. Will share export sizes in a sec.

Maggie: Export sizes (attaching):

```
filename,platform,width,height
hero-launch.png,x,1200,675
hero-launch.png,linkedin,1200,627
carousel1-1.png,x,1080,1080
```

Nate: Sales ask — route inbound leads with HS property "source=social" and tag "webinar_interest"; if lead_score > 50 then auto-assign to AE queue. Also add a webhook to send basic event payload to SFDC.

Anya: I'll set up HubSpot routing. @Maggie can you add alt text for each image and short descriptions for LinkedIn long form?

Maggie: Yep, adding alt text now and will drop the text in the same Figma file.

Sam: Timeline recap: copy drafts by EOD today, final assets by 10:00am PT tomorrow, I'll schedule once assets + UTM templates are in. :thumbsup:

amplify-bot: Reminder — please include UTM params on every campaign link. Publishing blocked until UTMs present.

Emma: Added UTM template: ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=prod_launch_v1&utm_medium=organic. LinkedIn long form should link to webinar reg: https://redwood.ai/webinar.

Emma: Also want one benchmark tweet that calls out quantifiable numbers and one softer customer quote in the LinkedIn post.

Sam: Noted. I'll map which copy goes where and tag owners.

Emma: Thanks everyone — big launch push, appreciate the quick turn. :raised_hands:
